events_chronological: At a works outing beside a stream, a young man sits away from the crowd with a girl from the packing line and tells her he intends to take photographs for a living.
The girl presses a tin of mints into his hand, and he watches a goods train pass with the feeling that everything is about to begin.
Called up, he is sent with his company to break a rising in a provincial city and takes a bullet through the calf.
Bleeding and terrified in the dark, he fires at a shape in a doorway and kills a schoolgirl who was trying to get home.
Years later, as a detective, he beats a student in a cell and finds that the work suits him.
The girl from the packing line brings him a camera she has saved up for; he refuses it and spends the night with a waitress.
He tortures an organiser in a country town, then washes his hands and sits down to a bowl of rice.
He marries a good-humoured woman he does not love and lets his colleagues arrange the whole wedding.
He runs a small furniture firm, strikes his wife, and learns she is sleeping with the man teaching her to drive.
He follows her, catches the two of them and beats the man, then returns to a mistress of his own.
The firm fails, his partner takes what money is left, and his wife walks out.
He buys a pistol and drives about the city unable to settle on who deserves it.
The husband of the girl from the packing line brings him to her hospital bed, where she is dying and cannot speak, and returns the camera she once bought.
He forces his way into a reunion picnic beside the same stream, climbs onto a railway bridge, and stands facing an oncoming train shouting that he wants to go back.
nonlinear_category_reason: Scene order runs from the latest stretch to the earliest throughout, with no present-day level the telling returns to. Seven dated episodes run from a suicide back to a factory picnic twenty years earlier, with reversed footage of a railway line between them.
syuzhet_notes: Seven dated episodes run in reverse across twenty years, from the suicide to the works outing. Between them the film holds on a railway line shot from a moving train and played backwards, so the landscape itself runs the wrong way.
fabula_notes: Chronology is fixed by the caption opening each episode. The death told first is the latest event in the story and the outing told last is the earliest.

events.content: At a streamside outing he sits apart with a young coworker and imagines a life organised around looking carefully rather than exercising power over anyone.
events.location: a stream beside a works outing

the packing-line girl: the man hopes to become a photographer
reader: the young man begins with tenderness and an artistic future

events.content: Her small gift and the passing goods train fix the outing as a beginning both of them expect to remember happily.

the man: the packing-line girl cares about the future he described
reader: the mints and train become markers of the life he later wants back

core: the man to suppress a rising
events.content: Conscription replaces the imagined artistic future with a night deployment in a provincial city, where a bullet through his calf leaves him frightened and disoriented.
events.location: a provincial city during a rising

the man: the deployment is chaotic and he is wounded
reader: state violence abruptly interrupts the streamside future

questions.q9: what will the wounded conscript fire at in the darkness?

events.content: Bleeding in darkness, he fires at a doorway and discovers that the perceived threat was a child trying to reach home.

the man: his frightened shot killed a schoolgirl
reader: the formative act of violence is accidental, irreversible and never repaired

events.content: Years later he performs institutional violence deliberately, discovering in an interrogation cell that authority rewards the hardness learned during the rising.

the man: his colleagues accept and value his brutality
reader: the frightened conscript has become an officer who inflicts fear

questions.q3: what first joined the man's fear to the violence he later performs deliberately?

events.content: The packing-line girl offers the instrument linked to his old ambition, but he refuses both it and the self it represents before spending the night with a waitress.
events.location: the city and a hotel room

the packing-line girl: the man rejects the camera and their shared past
reader: he consciously turns away from his unrealised gentle vocation

events.content: He moves from pain in an interrogation room to an ordinary meal without visible transition, showing that cruelty has become routine work.

reader: the man can now compartmentalise torture as part of a normal day

core: a woman he does not love
events.content: Colleagues arrange the wedding as another expected institution, and his passive acceptance replaces any personal choice comparable to the streamside promise.

the wife: the man's colleagues have shaped the marriage celebration
reader: the man enters marriage without the intimacy he rejected earlier

events.content: In the failing furniture-business years, his violence reaches home while a driving lesson gives his wife a relationship outside the marriage.
events.location: the family home and furniture firm

the man: his wife is sleeping with her driving instructor
reader: the loveless marriage now contains violence and reciprocal betrayal

events.content: He follows the pair, assaults his rival and then returns to a mistress of his own, demanding fidelity he does not practise.
events.location: a roadside and the mistress's room

the wife: her husband knows about the affair and answers it violently
reader: the man's grievance coexists with his own infidelity

events.content: Business failure removes his money, partnership and marriage in quick succession, stripping away the adult identities he used in place of his abandoned ambition.
events.location: the failed furniture firm and family home

the man: his partner took the remaining money and his wife has left
reader: the man's business and domestic life collapse together

questions.q5: what had broken the marriage before the wife finally left?
questions.q10: what kind of marriage preceded the wife's departure?

events.content: He circles the city with a weapon but cannot decide whether rage belongs to his partner, wife, rival or himself.

reader: the pistol expresses diffuse despair rather than a settled revenge plan

events.content: At the dying woman's bedside, the object once refused comes back to the ruined man while she can no longer speak or answer anything he might say.

the man: the packing-line girl kept the camera and is dying
reader: the rejected future returns only when it cannot be recovered

questions.q4: why did the dying woman once buy the camera now being returned?

events.content: At the old stream he invades a reunion, climbs onto the railway bridge and asks to return while the train that once marked possibility now closes the story.

reader: the man's demand to go back refers to the innocence, relationship and vocation progressively revealed in reverse

questions.q1: what earlier self and future is the man asking to recover?
questions.q2: why do the stream and passing train carry such force at his death?
questions.q6: what immediate collapse brought the man to the bridge?
questions.q7: why is the man already moving through the city as if choosing a death?
questions.q8: what final encounter makes returning to the past feel urgent?
